newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter tops futures fund managers in Feb 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter tops futures fund managers in Feb 1997.

text.p: Dean Witter's Composite Foreign Exchange fund ranked as the top futures fund manager in February, for the second consecutive month, among programs surveyed by fund monitor, TASS Management Ltd.
Dean Witter Composite Foreign Exchange posted a 9.65 percent return for February and a 32.69 pct return for the first two months of the year, Tass chief executive Nicola Meaden said.
"It was an interesting month in that top futures managers profited from positions in both the commodity and financial markets," Meaden said.
Futures fund managers who traded in the coffee and grains markets realized the best returns in the month of February, she said.

Many of the top ten managers for the month reaped many of their trading gains by going long in the coffee and grain markets, while other successful strategies included going long in the US dollar and shorting natural gas.

Coffee prices have risen about 75 pct so far in the first quarter of 1997, while soybeans are up about 18 percent and corn is up about 19 pct. Natural gas prices have lost about 17 pct, analysts noted.
All of the top ten futures trading programs for February were technically oriented in their trading strategies.
"February was a respectable month for peformance, following a very strong showing in January," Meaden said.

In January futures managers focusing on trading in the foreign exchange markets recorded the best returns, with the US dollar hitting 34 month highs against the deutschemark and 48 month highs against yen.
The TASS monthly report follows the peformance of 70 commodity trading programs, each with a minimum of $45 million under management.
TASS Management Ltd is a London-based research company which tracks about 1,600 alternative investment managers and funds globally who manage about $9 billion in assets.
"Alternative" investments programs include hedge funds, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), managed currency programs, emerging market funds and funds of funds.
